verdict.rationale: Agora documents its own RESTful APIs for console-type tasks such as creating projects and fetching usage programmatically, and it offers a CLI and MCP server for agent workflows. However, the docs direct users to the Agora Console for generating temporary tokens and for invalidating or creating App Certificates, so parity with the UI is not shown. Missing for 10: documented API coverage of all Console functions (certificate rotation, token generation), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404), and any explicit parity statement or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Agora also provides RESTful APIs that you use to implement features such as creating a project and fetching usage numbers programmatically.
Connect the CLI, MCP server, and Skills to your AI workflow.
